title: Ontology of Continua Core v1.3.3
description:
Ontology of Continua Core v1.3.3 is a bounded external-review scientific release of the OC core model. It provides typed foundations, proof/evidence ledgers, Lean and finite-model evidence, target-blind validation summaries, reproducibility material, and adversarial-review closure artifacts.

The release promotes only model-core claims supported by the included evidence. Broader full-science completion and universal modern-science-superiority obligations remain outside this release surface.

Recommended reading order

  1. Science Monolith - OC_CORE_1_3_3_MASTER_MONOGRAPH_EN.pdf
  2. Journal Core - OC_CORE_1_3_3_JOURNAL_CORE_EN.pdf
  3. Methods and Reproducibility Companion - OC_CORE_1_3_3_METHODS_AND_REPRODUCIBILITY_COMPANION_EN.pdf
  4. Reviewer Attack and Response Map - OC_CORE_1_3_3_REVIEWER_ATTACK_AND_RESPONSE_MAP_EN.pdf
  5. Public reproducibility package - oc_core_1_3_3_public_release.zip

Release contents

  • Four substantive English PDF documents.
  • One public reproducibility package with proof, validation, review, metadata, checksums, and journal owner-review materials.
  • Checksums are provided in checksums.txt.

Citation and links

  • Version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19957779
  • Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.17899134
  • Zenodo record

Governance boundary

GitHub Release and Zenodo publication are approved for v1.3.3. Journal packages are included as owner-review material only; journal submission, email campaigns, and Software Heritage deposit require separate approval.
